## 4. Detailed Chronological Experience (2004 – 2026)

### John Deere — AI Architect & Technical Lead (Official Title: Senior Data Scientist)
*01/2023 – 10/2026 | Pune, India | Analytics, Automation & Process Improvement — Customer & Product Support*
- Owned end-to-end solution architecture, AWS platform, and production delivery for **23+ AI initiatives**, working directly with technical writers, product engineers, and support teams from problem discovery and PoC ROI validation to full production scale (**FY26: 750K+ automated requests, 42K+ hours saved**).
- **StoneAge Engineering Writing Copilot:** Built an AI authoring copilot directly inside the company's engineering system of record (Windchill PLM ecosystem). Authors draft and validate service manuals using approved enterprise knowledge, task-level multi-model routing (**GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini**), and automatic safety-critical wording detection. Tech stack: LangGraph agents, OpenSearch hybrid lexical+vector search, React, FastAPI, Okta OAuth 2.0.
- **Failing GenAI Product Turnaround (~30% → ~70% Accuracy):** Replaced an underperforming single-LLM architecture (~30% accuracy) with a structured multi-step agent workflow that parses engineering diagrams via **GPT-4o Vision**, routes by equipment family, and validates outputs against domain rules — reaching **~70% accuracy** and active daily usage by **46 authors**.
- **6-Agent Neo4j GraphRAG System:** Preserved hierarchical structure across complex engineering manuals during ingestion and built a 6-agent authoring team backed by a **Neo4j knowledge graph** so every answer cites verifiable source nodes.
- **AIFlow (255-Metric Evaluation & Monitoring):** Engineered an internal 255-check LLM evaluation library integrated into CI pipelines as a hard release gate, plus asynchronous live monitoring of accuracy, drift, token spend, and latency without slowing user responses.
- **Production Safety & Auditability:** Enforced human-in-the-loop safety where agents can modify official engineering records *only* after a fresh explicit user approval with full audit trails; prioritized search-plus-rules over model fine-tuning so outputs remain auditable as products evolve.
- **Scale Automation:** Repaired ~171K broken cross-manual links (~8,600 hrs saved); generated ~110K standards-compliant documents (100% adoption in Large Tractor unit); automated ~25% of support tickets end-to-end at ~83% accuracy with human escalation (~4,700 hrs saved).
- **Cloud Platform & Leadership:** Built a self-service AWS deployment platform (**Terraform, GitHub Actions**) adopted across the department and 3 partner organizations while owning AWS FinOps cost; led a 12+ member team, ran design reviews and hiring panels, mentored 3 engineers, sat on the **AI Governance Council (NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act)**, and co-led 3 years of digital/AI transformation enabling 300+ employees.

## 5. Selected Public Open-Source Repositories (`github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`)

- **`tracegit`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit`): Local-First Git for AI Agent Execution Traces — native `C++20` Wagner–Fischer trajectory step alignment (`diff` + `bisect`), period `p=1..3` loop-thrash detector, SQLite SHA-256 Merkle DAG store, CI regression gate, and drop-in Claude Code / Cursor `MCP` server (`97.55%` test coverage).
- **`syntara`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara`, release `v1.0.0`): Grammar-constrained structured decoding: JSON Schema/regex → minimal byte DFA → native C++20 prefix-sharing token index (112–142×, bit-exact), byte-level Earley CFG constraints, and exact closed-set choice scoring. 20/20 schema-valid outputs vs 1/20 unconstrained; 157 tests at 99.7% coverage.
- **`tokendiet`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tokendiet`, release `v1.0.0`): Drop-in AI agent context compressor: native C++20 order-preserving salience knapsack, Python AST skeletonizer, cross-turn read dedup, cascade FinOps router, and Claude Code MCP server. Live qwen3.5:4b audit: 6/6 accuracy preserved with 70.25% prompt-token reduction; 14 tests at 97.72% coverage.
- **`slopguard`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/slopguard`, release `v1.0.0`): Sub-second AI code & UI anti-slop verifier: C++20 byte prescreener, Python AST & TypeScript/JSX slop gate, Claude Code PostToolUse hook, and MCP server. Live qwen3.5:4b repair audit: 0/6 → 6/6 passing, 9 blockers eliminated; 12 tests at 97.12% coverage.
- **`vecta`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta`, release `v1.0.0`): From-scratch vector search: HNSW (0.999 recall@10 touching 1.4% of vectors), IVF-PQ ADC + rerank (24× compression), RaBitQ-style 1-bit codes, BM25+RRF hybrid, and bit-exact native C++20 kernels (L2 7.8×, ADC 11.2×, Hamming 20.8×). mypy --strict, 99%+ branch coverage.
- **`weavegraph`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph`, release `v1.0.0`): Semantic code-graph worktree scheduler, min-cut multi-agent task partitioner, and 3-way AST semantic merge verifier (C++20 + Python + MCP + React). CI enforces ruff, mypy and a ≥95% coverage gate.
- **`nexus-verity`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/nexus-verity`): Pearl Causal DAG & `PC-Stable` Discovery (`SHD=0`), Chernozhukov 5-Fold Cross-Fitted Neyman-Orthogonal Double/Debiased ML (`919x` Simpson's-Paradox bias reduction), Vovk Finite-Sample Split Conformal Prediction, and native `C++20` Doubly-Robust Off-Policy Evaluator.
- **`aether-compiler`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aether-compiler`): MLIR/TorchInductor-Style Typed SSA Tensor Graph Compiler, Algebraic/CSE/DCE & Epilogue Fusion (`2.18x` HBM cut), native `C++20` Linear-Scan Static Activation Arena (`432 MiB -> 120 MiB`, `3.60x`), and Polyhedral H100 `CuTe` `32->1` Bank-Conflict Autotuner.
0. **`helios-consensus`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/helios-consensus`): FoundationDB-Style Deterministic Simulation Raft Engine, TLA+-Style Explicit-State BFS Model Checker (`985` states + minimal `4`-step mutant trace), Chained HotStuff `3`-Chain BFT Finality (`N=3f+1`), and native `C++20` Lamping–Veach Jump Consistent Hash & Castagnoli `CRC32C` WAL Kernels.
1. **`privora-graph`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/privora-graph`): Sovereign Differential Privacy (`DP-SGD` Binomial Rényi Accountant, `ε=4.14, δ=1e-5`, `-90.3%` MIA leakage), `SQL:2011` Bi-Temporal Knowledge Graph with native `C++20` CSR Personalized PageRank (`0/6` retroactive compliance leaks), and `Multi-Krum` / Weiszfeld Byzantine federated aggregation.
2. **`veritas-rl`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/veritas-rl`): Frontier RLVR Post-Training & 2D Parallelism Engine — critic-free GRPO/DAPO verifiable-reward RL, ICML '24 Oral DoRA weight decomposition, causal Online-Softmax Ring-Attention + Megatron 2D TP, native C++20 advantage kernels, and Step-Level PRM test-time compute.
2. **`axiom-zero`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/axiom-zero`): Verified Frontier Transformer Runtime — RoPE + GQA + SwiGLU Transformer with CoW Paged-KV, native C++20 lossless speculative decoding kernel, Anthropic-style Top-K Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) circuit steering, and 1-UIP CDCL RUP proof checker.
3. **`quant-forge`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/quant-forge`): Sub-Byte LLM Compression & Hardware Roofline Engine — native C++20 2-weights/byte INT4 register-fused GEMM (6.40x byte compression), Second-Order Cholesky GPTQ (25.49x lower MSE), Salient-Channel AWQ, SpinQuant Walsh-Hadamard incoherence rotation, and OCP FP8 E4M3/E5M2.
4. **`aegis-runtime`** (`https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime`): Deterministic Zero-Trust Control Plane & Transactional Saga Engine for Enterprise AI Agents — formal `.aegis` AST policy compiler, Biba/Bell-LaPadula taint lattices, AES-256-GCM PII vault, orchestrated SAP/ERP compensating rollbacks, and RFC-6962 Merkle + Ed25519 audit ledger.
